author: ClaudeDevs
name: ClaudeDevs
text:
Try these in your first Opus 5.5 session:

→ Hand over a whole task. Define "done" and when to check in.
→ Drop "think carefully". It always thinks first.
→ After a long run, check what it needs to go further.

Our playbook: https://t.co/h4Vz9BIl0z

author: ClaudeDevs
name: ClaudeDevs
text:
Opus 5.5 performs at the level of Fable 5.1. It's ~30% faster and ~40% cheaper than Opus 5 per task.

In Claude Code:
- 5-hour session limits increase 20% today
- Opus 5.5 is priced lower, so it goes 25% further within limits
- Pro, Max, and Team users get a reset to use anytime https://t.co/1seRYKAtzJ

Introducing Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in our new Claude 5.5 family.

It performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 for most tasks, and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5. https://t.co/Q9C2VKQ79f

author: ClaudeDevs
name: ClaudeDevs
text:
As our models grow more powerful, safeguards are one way we prevent misuse. Opus 5.5 is the first Opus with Fable 5.1-class safeguards on cyber, bio, and frontier LLM development.

Flagged requests fall back to another model, and we're working to reduce incorrect flags.

author: ClaudeDevs
name: ClaudeDevs
text:
Opus 5.5 is available now in Claude Code and the Claude Platform.

With its intelligence, lower price, and speed, it's our new daily driver for coding and agentic work. We hope it'll become yours too.

author: ClaudeDevs
name: ClaudeDevs
text:
Today we're rolling out Projects in Claude Code on desktop and web.

A project is one conversation with Claude. It splits the work into threads itself, runs them as parallel cloud sessions, passes context between them, and keeps going when you leave.

In beta for select users. https://t.co/j4k7rludhV

author: ClaudeDevs
name: ClaudeDevs
text:
Available today for Pro and Max users who already run cloud sessions and haven't used Claude Projects yet.

If you've used Projects before, we're rolling out to you slightly later so your existing ones move over cleanly. 

Want access now anyway? Join the waitlist:

https://t.co/mLhobtZfpR

author: ClaudeDevs
name: ClaudeDevs
text:
Threads run in the cloud, even when your computer is not online. Support for local workflows is coming very soon.

More in the docs: https://t.co/NhA6H16fGF

author: ClaudeDevs
name: ClaudeDevs
text:
Claude Design, Claude Slides and Claude Docs also work inside Claude Code now.

Ask for a design review deck or a UI mockup and point it at the actual files and RFCs in the repo. Edit it yourself or keep going in the conversation, and share the link when it's ready.

quoted_tweet.author: claudeai
quoted_tweet.name: Claude
quoted_tweet.text:
You can also now make decks, docs, and designs in your conversation.

Draft the one-pager in Claude Docs, turn it into a deck with Claude Slides, and mock up a matching visual in Claude Design, all from one place. https://t.co/Y0JaJGT3G8
